hook: WHY DOES THIS *KING HAVE A *GOAT'S HEAD?
title: 31 · goat_king · The Goat-Headed King
lines: There is a king in the old stories with the head of a goat.
It was the kindest thing anyone ever did for him.
driven his own daughter into the fire,
and lost his head for it.
The worlds stopped. No sacrifice. No rain.
The gods walked to Kailash on foot to beg.
His anger had been spent in a single night.
He was a foolish father. Not an evil one. Bring him back.
But the king's own head was ash.
So they used the head of the goat meant for his sacrifice.
The first thing he saw was the god he had hated.
The proud voice was gone. All that came out was a bleat.
The sacrifice was finished properly this time.
With the first share set aside for Shiva.
You do not get your old head back. You get a humbler one. That is sadhana.
